source.document: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended
source.authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
source.note: Consolidated text sourced from consumeraffairs.gov.in compiled PDF (last updated 2022); cross-checked against 2026 amendment notifications (Feb 2026 e-commerce CoO filter rule, May 2026 Third Amendment) via third-party regulatory trackers. Neither 2026 amendment modifies the fields below.

scope: MVP: physical retail-package label declarations only. Excludes: font-size-in-mm measurement (deferred, requires physical calibration), wholesale packages (Rule 24), export packages (Rule 25), e-commerce listing-level rules (Rule 6(10A), platform not label), commodity-specific packaged-quantity restrictions (Second Schedule).

fields.title: Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer
fields.condition: Label must declare name AND address of manufacturer; if manufacturer != packer, both must appear; imported packages must additionally show importer name/address.

amendment_history.change: Explanation III (food articles) reference updated to FSS Act 2006

fields.violation_template: Mandatory declaration of manufacturer/packer/importer name and address is missing or incomplete.

fields.title: Country of origin (imported products only)
fields.applicability: Only applies when package is identified as an imported product.
fields.condition: If imported, label must declare country of origin/manufacture/assembly.
fields.violation_template: Imported product does not declare country of origin as required.

fields.title: Common or generic name of commodity
fields.condition: Label must state the common/generic name; for multi-product packs, name and quantity of each product.
fields.violation_template: Common or generic name of the commodity is not declared on the label.

fields.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) + Rule 22 + First Schedule Table I/II
fields.title: Net quantity, within permissible error tolerance
fields.condition: Label must declare net quantity in standard unit (weight/volume) or count. Declared value is evaluated for tolerance banding via First Schedule Table I (weight/volume, units g or ml) or Table II (length/area/number) — this check validates the DECLARATION format/banding requirement, not a physical re-measurement of package contents (MVP has no calibrated-camera measurement; that is out of scope).
fields.rounding_rule: Percentage-derived error rounds to nearest 0.1 g/ml for declared quantity <= 1000 g/ml; rounds up to next whole g/ml above 1000 g/ml.

length.rule: 2% of declared quantity up to 10 metre and thereafter 1% of declared quantity.

area.rule: 4% of declared quantity up to 10 sq. metre and thereafter 1% of declared quantity.

fields.violation_template: Net quantity declaration is missing, or does not state a standard unit / countable number as required.
fields.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 22, First Schedule Table I/II, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
fields.known_limitation: MVP validates the DECLARATION (presence, unit, band-consistent formatting). It cannot verify the physical package actually contains the declared quantity within tolerance without a calibrated weighing/measuring step, which is out of scope for a photo-only MVP.

fields.title: Month and year of manufacture/pre-pack/import
fields.condition: Label must state month and year of manufacture/pre-packing, in words or numerals.
exemptions: Food articles (governed by FSS Act 2006 instead)
Seeds certified under the Seeds Act, 1966
Cosmetics (governed by Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 instead)
14.2kg or 5kg domestic LPG cylinders marketed by a PSU
fields.violation_template: Month and year of manufacture/pre-packing is not declared on the label.

fields.title: Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes)
fields.condition: Label must state MRP in Indian currency, explicitly inclusive of all taxes (e.g. 'MRP Rs. xx.xx incl. of all taxes').
exemptions: LPG cylinders priced under the Administrative Price Mechanism
Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor (governed by State Excise law unless silent on MRP)
Essential commodities with a price fixed/notified under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955
fields.violation_template: MRP is not declared, or is not explicitly stated as inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency.

fields.title: Consumer care contact (name, address, phone, e-mail if available)
fields.condition: Label must declare name, address, and telephone number (and e-mail if available) of the consumer-complaints contact.
fields.violation_template: Consumer care contact details are missing or incomplete.
